description: This Java source file defines the KafkaAdmin class, which manages Kafka topics and consumer groups, including creation, deletion, offset synchronization, and status checks within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: KafkaAdmin
classes.description: A class providing administrative operations for Kafka, such as topic management, consumer group offset handling, and lag calculation within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: createTopicIfNotExists
methods.description: Creates a Kafka topic if it does not already exist or if forced, with specified properties.

methods.name: getTotalLagForGroupsBulk
methods.description: Calculates total consumer lag for multiple consumer groups.

methods.name: getTotalConsumerGroupLag
methods.description: Calculates total lag for a specific consumer group.

methods.name: getConsumerGroupOffsets
methods.description: Retrieves current offsets for a consumer group.

methods.name: syncOffsets
methods.description: Synchronizes offsets from a 'fat' consumer group to a single-partition group.

methods.name: syncOffsetsUnsafe
methods.description: Performs unsafe offset synchronization between consumer groups for specific topic partitions.

methods.name: isTopicEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a specific Kafka topic is empty.

methods.name: areAllTopicsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a set of Kafka topics are all empty.

methods.name: deleteConsumerGroup
methods.description: Deletes a specified Kafka consumer group.
